newsitem.title: FINLAND: KONECRANES SEES LAST '96 TERTIAL ON TRACK.
newsitem.headline: KONECRANES SEES LAST '96 TERTIAL ON TRACK.

text.p: Finnish cranes maker KCI Konecranes International Oy said in a statement on Thursday it expected the performance of most of its businesss to be on track during the final four-month period of 1996.
"During the second tertial of the year, the positive trends have continued, partially even stronger than before," Konecranes said in its January-August interim report.
"We foresee most of the group's businesses performing according to our expectations during the third tertial of the year," it said.
It said in May it expected earnings to continue to grow this year.
In 1995, Konecranes had a 135.3 million markka full-year profit.
Konecranes' January-August profit after financial items rose to 91.9 million markka from 53.0 million.

The group's order backlog rose to 1,004 million markka by the end of August from 835 million markka in August 1995. A significant part of the order backlog will be delivered in 1997 and 1998, it said.
